zoomPalettePolicy.colourSpace: sRGB swatches decode to linear RGB before blending; encode once at output
zoomPalettePolicy.formula: C_linear = sum(fraction_i * srgbToLinear(palette_i)); fractions >= 0 and sum = 1 after area-weighted reprojection
zoomPalettePolicy.seasonBlend: Interpolate corresponding class colours in linear RGB using local phenology state; calendar only fallback. Crop stage and water state have separate masks.
zoomPalettePolicy.snowOverlay: Base class fractions*(1-snowFraction) plus snow_ice*snowFraction; snowFraction from actual supported coverage, not all winter ground
zoomPalettePolicy.unknownData: Neutral inherited class palette; do not invent species, irrigation, crop type or shoreline changes
zoomPalettePolicy.resolution: Area-weighted land-cover fractions in equal-area space before reprojection; blend ecotones by coverage, not state/metro boundaries
zoomPalettePolicy.continents: Same palettes/fractions at region and continent, coarser polygons; no separate vivid continent tint
zoomPalettePolicy.wetness: Weather material response applies once after seasonal base colour; no albedo shadow bake
zoomPalettePolicy.night: Use unchanged street-to-space night appearance palette/state as the documented fallback; do not multiply day seasonal colours by arbitrary night tint or add duplicate exposure
zoomPalettePolicy.minimumFeaturePolicy: Under 6 drawable pixels aggregate/cull; preserve source water connectivity until unresolved, never widen roads or rivers artificially

cropStagePolicy: Per crop/elevation/water mask: bare -> emergent -> green -> ripe (only appropriate crop, e.g. cereal) -> harvested stubble. Different crops may be harvested green; winter crops may stay green in calendar winter. Seasonal regional cropland hex is an aggregate fallback, never a crop calendar.

dataSelectionPolicy.fieldGeometry: Preserve observed polygons, mapped pivot shape and drainage; do not stamp a grid or circle from region name
dataSelectionPolicy.smallTownPlacement: Only source settlement/building footprint; proposed facade family never creates houses in wilderness
dataSelectionPolicy.wetlands: Use freshwater/saline/hydroperiod masks; flooding overrides broad calendar colour
dataSelectionPolicy.dateFallback: Calendar seasons only when local phenology unavailable; identify fallback as inferred
